regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Pardon my tardiness in complying with demands of -- correspondence. Thanks be to God I've had some really practical exercises recently that befit a capuchin novitiate ..... Four weeks ago we drove over to Milwaukee for a celebration in honor of Fr. Stephen Eckert, whose Dominicad (Dominican brother) Br. Michael you must have .... . From Notre Dame .... Afterwards they ambulanced me to St. Michael's Hospital - thence after two days to St. Felix - St. Joseph Hospital Ft. Wayne for two long weeks (16 days) and now again back to the Novitiate .... Deo Gratias. They seem to think they had pretty critical patient I can genuflect again .... and can eat - "no foolin." Now to catch up a little with letters, etc .... God help us ... I surely sympathize with you and your practical associate .. . . Best wishes to all ...... including down to the personnel of St. Joseph Hospital where I met such really fraternal and sister- like encouragement !.... I always bring away with me newly awakened memories from St. Thomas.
